name: Shantungosuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in a shartegosuchid/shartegosuchoid group that has no clade entry in the atlas yet; placed in the nearest atlas ancestor.
sum: Shantungosuchus is an Early Cretaceous crocodyliform from China with three named species.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Specimens of three species from the Luohandong and Mengyin formations.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Young 1961
